interpretation: Primary P0 evidence is mixed, so the overall recommendation is WEAK/INCONCLUSIVE. The OPEN-state whole-day closing-half-hour contrast is -1.196 percentage points (block5 interval -2.131 to -0.294); after post-10:00 renormalization it is -1.160pp, but the block10 interval crosses zero (-2.355 to +0.053pp). PREV primary closing-half-hour and midday contrasts are uncertain. A promising, separately labeled supplementary PREV closing-hour contrast is +2.005pp (block10 +0.839 to +3.206pp), with positive remaining-day, drop-top1 and median contrasts; it is not promoted to the primary window. Remaining-day profile TV is0.0361 OPEN and0.0444 PREV, below the C-spec reporting tolerance0.05 as point estimates only, with no equivalence inference. These signals warrant design-thread review, not a claim that the RV-state extension has been confirmed or ruled out.

rubric.GO: Reproducible interpretable nonopening normalized differences, relative to within-group dispersion, broadly robust to top1/median and both block lengths. Exploratory only.
rubric.NO_GO: Almost indistinguishable nonopening profiles under robust comparisons in this SPY proxy/date span; not an equivalence proof.
rubric.WEAK: Minor/uncertain or mechanically dominated opening contrast, fragile or discordant evidence; no numerical threshold selected from results.
